description.value:
You call forth a titanic robot. The robot occupies the space of a Huge creature, and has a Speed of 80 feet and a fly Speed of 100 feet with the cosmic trait.

Arrive Ultra Cannon Onslaught (traversal) The robot Strides once in a straight line, trampling enemies underfoot to deal @Damage[10d8[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage (basic Reflex save). It then unleashes a volley of lasers from its chest in a @Template[type:cone|distance:60] or @Template[type:line|distance:120], which can't overlap with the area of the its Stride, dealing @Damage[10d8[force]|options:area-damage] damage (basic Reflex save).

Depart Missile Silo Unleashed The robot fires rockets at up to 8 different creatures up to 120 feet away, dealing @Damage[9d8[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (basic Reflex save).

duration.value: until the end of your next turn
